name: wemind
description: WeMind — your AI mind, reachable on WeChat. Monorepo: reusable iLink protocol core, a publishable MCP server, and a private always-on daemon.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @wemind/wechat-ilink-core && npm run build -w wemind -w @wemind/wechat-mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @wemind/wechat-ilink-core && npm run typecheck -w wemind -w @wemind/wechat-mcp
